# KODA

> KODA is a web design studio in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. We design and build fast, mobile friendly websites for small and medium businesses, and we set up Google Business Profiles and SEO. Every website includes managed hosting with SSL, backups and monitoring, and support after launch.

## Facts
- Name: KODA (also written "KODA Web Design" or "HeyKoda")
- Location: Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. We serve Durban, Umhlanga, Ballito, Pinetown and Westville, and work with clients remotely.
- Contact: hello@heykoda.co.za, phone 061 244 0166 (+27 61 244 0166)
- Website: https://www.heykoda.co.za/
- Free offer: a free homepage mock-up before you pay anything.

## Services
- Website design and redesign
- Ecommerce stores
- Online booking systems
- Logo and branding
- Google Business Profile setup
- SEO optimisation, and SEO with social media
- Website maintenance (updates, backups, security monitoring, small changes)

## Prices (South African rand, once off)
- Starter: R3,499. One page website, WhatsApp button and contact form, Google Maps, basic SEO, managed hosting, Google Business Profile setup. Typically 5 to 7 working days.
- Business: R7,999. Five page website, photo gallery and testimonials, on page SEO and Google indexing setup. Typically 2 to 4 weeks.
- Custom: from R14,999. Online booking or online store, advanced SEO, custom integrations. Timeline agreed with the client.
- Monthly plans cover updates and changes. We do the updating for the client; there is no editor to learn.

## Honest limits
- We cannot promise a particular Google ranking.
